title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: vignette illustrates complete workflow download daily meteorological data AEMET OpenData convert functional data objects fda.usc package using aemet2fdata. AEMET OpenData portal: https://opendata.aemet.es/centrodedescargas/inicio API key request: https://opendata.aemet.es/centrodedescargas/altaUsuario Every functional object one curve per station year 365 points (argvals = 1:365). February 29 removed, column 60 always March 1. Missing days kept NA.

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: usual fda.usc tools apply directly:
code: fd_tmed <- aemet2fdata(file = f, var = "tmed") dim(fd_tmed) #> [1]   4 365 rownames(fd_tmed$data) #> [1] "1387_2023" "1387_2024" "B228_2023" "B228_2024" plot(fd_tmed, col = rep(c(2, 4), each = 2)) legend("topleft", legend = c("1387", "B228"), col = c(2, 4), lty = 1) plot(func.mean(fd_tmed), main = "Mean curve", lwd = 2)

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: aemet2lfdata() returns ldata object: df one row per curve (station-year) station metadata, one fdata per variable, rows. Subsets plots use ldata methods fda.usc:
code: ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = f, vars = c("tmed", "tmax", "tmin", "prec")) #> Station coordinates (lon, lat) not available: pass 'inventory' (see aemet2inventory()) or 'api_key'. names(ld) #> [1] "df"   "tmed" "tmax" "tmin" "prec" sapply(ld, NROW) #>   df tmed tmax tmin prec  #>    4    4    4    4    4 ld$df #>           station_id  station_name      province altitude lon lat wmo_id year #> 1387_2023       1387      A CORUÑA      A CORUÑA       57  NA  NA   <NA> 2023 #> 1387_2024       1387      A CORUÑA      A CORUÑA       57  NA  NA   <NA> 2024 #> B228_2023       B228 PALMA, PUERTO ILLES BALEARS        3  NA  NA   <NA> 2023 #> B228_2024       B228 PALMA, PUERTO ILLES BALEARS        3  NA  NA   <NA> 2024 #>           n_days #> 1387_2023    365 #> 1387_2024    365 #> B228_2023    365 #> B228_2024    365 is.ldata(ld) #> [1] TRUE ld_coruna <- subset(ld, ld$df$station_id == "1387") sapply(ld_coruna, NROW) #>   df tmed tmax tmin prec  #>    2    2    2    2    2 plot(ld$tmax, col = as.integer(factor(ld$df$station_id)),      main = "Maximum temperature")

code: api_key <- Sys.getenv("AEMET_API_KEY")

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: aemet2inventory() returns one row per station station_id, station_name, province, altitude (m), lon, lat (decimal degrees) wmo_id. Save reuse : daily data include coordinates, inventory provides lon lat ldata$df.
code: inv <- aemet2inventory(api_key = api_key, file = "inventory.rds") head(inv)

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
code: df <- aemet2df(   station_ids = c("1387", "B228"),   start_date = "2018-01-01",   end_date = "2020-12-31",   vars = c("tmed", "prec", "tmin", "tmax"),   api_key = api_key,   file = "mydata.csv" ) head(df)

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
code: ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = "mydata.csv", inventory = "inventory.rds") ld$df plot(ld)  # or directly from the API ld <- aemet2lfdata(   station_ids = c("1387", "B228"),   vars = c("tmed", "prec"),   start_date = "2018-01-01",   end_date = "2020-12-31",   api_key = api_key,   inventory = inv )

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: aemet2csv() requests station half-year windows (1 January-30 June 1 July-31 December, .e. two requests per year), recent backwards, writes one CSV per station whole daily history. CSV written UTF-8 whatever locale, station names accents “ñ” kept. Stations already downloaded skipped, interrupted run resumed running call .
code: log <- aemet2csv(c("1387"), start_date = "2006-01-01",                  end_date = "2025-12-31", api_key = api_key,                  out_dir = "aemet_csv") log  ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_csv/1387.csv",                    vars = c("tmed", "tmin", "tmax", "prec", "sol"),                    inventory = "inventory.rds") ld <- subset(ld, ld$df$n_days >= 365)          # complete years plot(ld$tmed, col = hcl.colors(nrow(ld$df), "Blue-Red 3"))

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: many stations years use aemet2download(): requests stations (AEMET todasestaciones service) short windows , year complete, saves one file per station year (aemet_daily/1387/1387_1976.rds, …). resumable: run call continue retry failed windows. pass directory aemet2lfdata() (optionally station_ids read stations). Station identifiers station_id (AEMET indicativo, e.g. "1387"), wmo_id.
code: log <- aemet2download(   start_date = "2006-01-01",   end_date   = "2025-12-31",   api_key    = api_key,   out_dir    = "aemet_daily",   vars       = c("tmed", "tmin", "tmax", "prec", "sol") ) table(log$status)  ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_daily", inventory = "inventory.rds") table(ld$df$year)  # complete years (>= 360 days) of stations with the 50 years ld  <- subset(ld, ld$df$n_days >= 360) ny  <- table(ld$df$station_id) ld50 <- subset(ld, ld$df$station_id %in% names(ny)[ny == 50])

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: fda.usc includes dataset aemet (73 stations, averages 1980-2009):  climatological (averaged) version, one curve per station, whereas aemet2fdata gives one curve per station year.
code: data(aemet) names(aemet) #> [1] "df"         "temp"       "wind.speed" "logprec" plot(aemet$temp, main = "fda.usc::aemet, mean temperature 1980-2009")

title: AEMET OpenData to Functional Data Workflow
text: Download inventory : aemet2inventory(api_key, file = "inventory.rds"). Download data : aemet2csv() (stations, whole history), aemet2download() (stations) aemet2df(..., file = "mydata.csv"). Build functional objects files: aemet2lfdata(file = "mydata.csv", inventory = "inventory.rds"). avoids repeated API calls respects AEMET OpenData service.

title: aemet2fdata
text: Two requests per year station (1 January-30 June, 1 July-31 December); one CSV per station UTF-8, station names accents “ñ” kept. Stations already downloaded skipped.
code: log <- aemet2csv("1387", start_date = "1926-01-01", end_date = "2025-12-31",                  api_key = api_key, out_dir = "aemet_csv") ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_csv/1387.csv",                    vars = c("tmed", "tmin", "tmax", "prec", "sol"),                    inventory = "inventory.rds")

title: aemet2fdata
code: # 1) station metadata (coordinates), once aemet2inventory(api_key = api_key, file = "inventory.rds")  # 2) all stations with data, one file per station and year #    (aemet_daily/1387/1387_1976.rds, ...); resumable: if it stops, run it again log <- aemet2download(   start_date = "1976-01-01", end_date = "2025-12-31",   api_key = api_key, out_dir = "aemet_daily",   vars = c("tmed", "tmin", "tmax", "prec", "sol") ) table(log$status)  # 3) ldata: one curve per station-year ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_daily", inventory = "inventory.rds") # or only some stations (reads only their files) ld2 <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_daily", station_ids = c("1387", "B228"),                     inventory = "inventory.rds") ld <- subset(ld, ld$df$n_days >= 360)     # complete years only saveRDS(ld, "aemet_ldata_1976_2025.rds")

title: aemet2fdata
text: Station identifiers station_id (AEMET indicativo, e.g. "1387"), wmo_id. One curve per station-year; row names "station_year" (e.g. "1387_2023") shared ldata$df every fdata. Leap years: February 29 removed (column 60 always March 1). Missing daily values kept NA. large downloads, save data (aemet2df(..., file = "x.csv")) build functional objects file; AEMET applies rate limits.

title: aemet2fdata
text: R packages access AEMET OpenData different goals: climaemet covers many AEMET services (daily, monthly, normals, extremes, forecasts, alerts) tidy spatial output climate graphics, meteospain gives common interface several Spanish meteorological services. aemet2fdata focuses long daily series stored locally (one file per station, per station year) conversion functional data fda.usc. Data source: © AEMET. Data use must cite AEMET source (https://www.aemet.es/es/nota_legal).

title: Download the daily history of each station to one CSV per station — aemet2csv
text: station, requests AEMET OpenData natural half-year windows (1 January - 30 June 1 July - 31 December; two requests per complete year) writes one CSV whole downloaded history station: default, windows requested recent backwards. Set reverse = FALSE request oldest forwards. dates always follow usual convention start_date <= end_date; reverse argument changes request order. station returned data, download stops stop_nodata consecutive empty half-years search direction. can save requests beginning old record (reverse = TRUE) end discontinued record (reverse = FALSE). Use stop_nodata = Inf request whole specified period. CSV uses ";" separator "," decimal mark (write.csv2) written UTF-8 BOM whatever locale, accents "ñ" kept Excel opens correctly. Read aemet2lfdata aemet2fdata (file = ). Stations whose file already exists skipped (overwrite = FALSE), interrupted run resumed running call . window fails, file station written station reported "incomplete": run retry .
code: out_dir/1387.csv out_dir/B228.csv

code: aemet2csv(   station_ids,   start_date,   end_date,   api_key,   out_dir = "aemet_csv",   vars = NULL,   reverse = TRUE,   stop_nodata = 10,   overwrite = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE,   control = list() )

title: Download the daily history of each station to one CSV per station — aemet2csv
text: station_ids Character vector station identifiers (station_id aemet2inventory, e.g. "1387"; wmo_id). start_date, end_date Character Date ("YYYY-MM-DD"), start_date <= end_date. api_key Character. AEMET OpenData API key. out_dir Directory CSV files (created needed). vars NULL (variables) character vector variables keep. Station columns (fecha, station_id, station_name, provincia, altitude) always kept. reverse Logical. TRUE (default), request half-years end_date backwards; FALSE, request start_date forwards. stop_nodata Number consecutive empty half-years, first data found, stops download station search direction. Inf requests whole specified period. overwrite Logical. Download stations whose file exists. verbose Logical. Progress messages. control List: max_attempts (3), retry_wait (60 s), sleep_pause (1.5 s requests), clean (TRUE).

title: Download the daily history of each station to one CSV per station — aemet2csv
text: Invisibly, data.frame one row per station: station_id, status ("ok", "exists", "nodata", "incomplete"), n_requests, n_failed, n_rows, first, last, file.

title: Bulk download of AEMET daily data: one file per station and year — aemet2download
text: Downloads daily climatological data AEMET OpenData long periods many stations saves one file per station year: file data.frame daily records station-year (fecha, station_id, station_name, provincia, altitude variables). default AEMET stations service (todasestaciones) used, every station data downloaded without giving list stations. AEMET serves short periods per request. default, -stations service uses 15-day windows; station_ids given, individual stations use natural half-years (1 January-30 June 1 July-31 December). Windows kept temporarily out_dir/_tmp , windows year downloaded, split station-year files deleted. download resumable: finished years skipped , inside unfinished year, windows already downloaded requested . process stops (rate limits, network, closing R), run call . Window files aemet_<start>_<end>.rds left out_dir version 0.2.0 function reused. Read result aemet2lfdata aemet2fdata passing out_dir file. title: Bulk download of AEMET daily data: one file per station and year — aemet2download
text: start_date, end_date Character Date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). api_key Character. AEMET OpenData API key. out_dir Directory files written (created needed). station_ids NULL (default) download stations todasestaciones service, character vector station identifiers (column station_id aemet2inventory, wmo_id) download one one. vars NULL (variables) character vector variables keep, e.g. c("tmed", "tmin", "tmax", "prec", "sol"). Station columns (fecha, station_id, station_name, provincia, altitude) always kept. window_days Length days request AEMET. NULL (default), -stations service uses 15-day windows, individual stations use natural half-years (1 January-30 June 1 July-31 December). positive integer uses fixed-length windows never cross end year. AEMET reports date range long, reduce value. format Format station-year files: "rds" (default) "csv" (separator ";", decimal ",", UTF-8). overwrite Logical. TRUE, years already finished downloaded . verbose Logical. Progress messages. control List advanced parameters: max_attempts (3), retry_wait (60 s), sleep_pause (1.5 s requests), clean (TRUE).

code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ api_key <- Sys.getenv("AEMET_API_KEY")  # 1) Station metadata (coordinates), once aemet2inventory(api_key = api_key, file = "inventory.rds")  # 2) All stations, 1976-2025: one file per station and year #    (long: if it stops, run it again) log <- aemet2download(   start_date = "1976-01-01",   end_date   = "2025-12-31",   api_key    = api_key,   out_dir    = "aemet_daily",   vars       = c("tmed", "tmin", "tmax", "prec", "sol") ) table(log$status) list.files("aemet_daily/1387")  # 3) Functional data: one curve per station-year ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_daily", inventory = "inventory.rds")  # only some stations (reads only their files) ld2 <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_daily", station_ids = c("1387", "B228"),                     inventory = "inventory.rds")  # complete years of stations with the 50 years ld <- subset(ld, ld$df$n_days >= 360) ny <- table(ld$df$station_id) ld50 <- subset(ld, ld$df$station_id %in% names(ny)[ny == 50]) } # } if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ api_key <- Sys.getenv("AEMET_API_KEY")  # 1) Station metadata (coordinates), once aemet2inventory(api_key = api_key, file = "inventory.rds")  # 2) All stations, 1976-2025: one file per station and year #    (long: if it stops, run it again) log <- aemet2download(   start_date = "1976-01-01",   end_date   = "2025-12-31",   api_key    = api_key,   out_dir    = "aemet_daily",   vars       = c("tmed", "tmin", "tmax", "prec", "sol") ) table(log$status) list.files("aemet_daily/1387")  # 3) Functional data: one curve per station-year ld <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_daily", inventory = "inventory.rds")  # only some stations (reads only their files) ld2 <- aemet2lfdata(file = "aemet_daily", station_ids = c("1387", "B228"),                     inventory = "inventory.rds")  # complete years of stations with the 50 years ld <- subset(ld, ld$df$n_days >= 360) ny <- table(ld$df$station_id) ld50 <- subset(ld, ld$df$station_id %in% names(ny)[ny == 50]) } # }

title: aemet2fdata: Functional Data from AEMET OpenData — aemet2fdata-package
text: Main functions: aemet2inventory: station metadata (id, name, province, altitude, longitude, latitude). aemet2df: daily data base-R data.frame. aemet2csv: whole daily history station, requested half-year windows, saved one CSV (UTF-8) per station. aemet2download: resumable bulk download (stations, long periods) one file per station year. aemet2fdata: one variable fdata object (one curve per station-year, 365 days). aemet2lfdata: several variables ldata object (df one row per curve plus one fdata per variable). example data file available system.file("extdata", "aemet_example.csv", package = "aemet2fdata") (daily data stations 1387, Coruña, B228, Palma Puerto, 2023-2024; source: AEMET OpenData). personal API key required download data: https://opendata.aemet.es/centrodedescargas/altaUsuario. R packages also access AEMET OpenData, different goals: climaemet (many AEMET services, tidy spatial output, climate graphics) meteospain (several Spanish meteorological services common format). aemet2fdata focuses long daily series stored locally conversion functional data. Data source: © AEMET (Agencia Estatal de Meteorología).

title: Build an fdata object from AEMET daily data — aemet2fdata
text: numeric meteorological variables converted functional data. output one row per station-year (row names "station_year", e.g. "1387_2023") 365 columns, days year (argvals = 1:365). Leap years: February 29 removed following days shifted back one position, column 60 always March 1. Missing daily values kept NA. Variable labels units assigned internal AEMET metadata, e.g. tmed: main = "temperature_mean", ylab = "Mean daily temperature (°C)" prec: main = "precipitation", ylab = "Daily precipitation (mm)"

text: Data can provided: existing data.frame (df) file (file) downloaded AEMET via aemet2df functional object : one curve per station-year 365 points per curve (February 29 removed; leap years days February 28 shifted back one position, column 60 always March 1) argvals = 1:365 ("days") first element, ldata$df, contains one row per curve, , one row per station-year combination: station metadata (station_id, station_name, province, altitude metres, lon lat decimal degrees wmo_id) repeated every year station, year identifies curve; n_days number days station-year present data (useful discard incomplete years, e.g. subset(ld, ld$df$n_days >= 360)). 4 curves (2 stations x 2 years) in every element #>   df tmed tmax tmin prec  #>    4    4    4    4    4  ld$df #>           station_id  station_name      province altitude lon lat wmo_id year #> 1387_2023       1387      A CORUÑA      A CORUÑA       57  NA  NA   <NA> 2023 #> 1387_2024       1387      A CORUÑA      A CORUÑA       57  NA  NA   <NA> 2024 #> B228_2023       B228 PALMA, PUERTO ILLES BALEARS        3  NA  NA   <NA> 2023 #> B228_2024       B228 PALMA, PUERTO ILLES BALEARS        3  NA  NA   <NA> 2024 #>           n_days #> 1387_2023    365 #> 1387_2024    365 #> B228_2023    365 #> B228_2024    365 fda.usc::is.ldata(ld) #> [1] TRUE  # fda.usc methods for ldata plot(ld$tmed, col = as.integer(factor(ld$df$station_id)))  ld2023 <- subset(ld, ld$df$year == 2023) sapply(ld2023, NROW) #>   df tmed tmax tmin prec  #>    2    2    2    2    2   # \dontrun{ # Download from the API api_key <- Sys.getenv("AEMET_API_KEY") inv <- aemet2inventory(api_key = api_key) ld3 <- aemet2lfdata(   station_ids = inv$station_id[1:2],   vars = c("tmed", "prec"),   start_date = "2019-01-01",   end_date = "2020-12-31",   api_key = api_key,   inventory = inv,   output_file = "aemet_ldata.rds" ) plot(ld3) } # title: aemet2fdata 0.2.0
text: aemet2lfdata() now builds one curve per station-year. Previously, curves different stations year mixed, ldata$df one row per station instead one row per curve. Now nrow(ldata$df) == nrow(ldata[[v]]) every functional variable, row names ("station_year", e.g. "1387_2023") shared df fdata elements. Leap years now handled correctly: February 29 removed days February shifted accordingly, column 60 always represents March 1. aemet2fdata() now correctly uses supplied data returns one curve per station-year, consistently aemet2lfdata(). aemet2inventory() now returns station metadata available AEMET inventory: station_id, station_name, province, altitude, lon, lat wmo_id (AEMET synoptic index indsinop). Conversion DMS coordinates decimal degrees accepts DDMMSS DDDMMSS formats. Station metadata ldata$df (province, altitude, lon, lat wmo_id) obtained inventory completed, possible, daily data. aemet2df() now converts numeric AEMET variables numeric, including humidity, pressure altitude variables. Previously subset meteorological variables converted. Station identifiers always kept character strings, identifiers leading zeros (e.g. "0076") preserved reading CSV files.

title: aemet2fdata 0.2.0
text: New aemet2csv() downloading long daily histories storing one CSV file per station (out_dir/<station_id>.csv). Downloads made natural half-year periods: 1 January 30 June 1 July 31 December first last periods truncated start_date end_date fall inside half-year. reverse = TRUE (default), periods requested recent backwards. reverse = FALSE, requested oldest forwards. start_date must always earlier equal end_date. downloading backwards, station stops stop_nodata consecutive empty half-years data found (stop_nodata = 4 default, corresponding two years). Existing station files skipped. request fails, station reported "incomplete" final CSV written, download can retried safely. aemet2df() uses natural half-year periods daily individual-station requests. New aemet2download() provides resumable bulk downloads long periods, saving one file per station year: out_dir/<station_id>/<station_id>_<year>.rds equivalent .csv file. default, uses AEMET todasestaciones service short window_days periods (15 days default), temporarily stores downloads out_dir/_tmp, splits station-year files. Completed station-years skipped failed windows can retried running call . station_ids supplied, individual-station downloads use natural half-year periods described . file aemet2fdata() aemet2lfdata() can single file, vector files directory. Directories read recursively, allows output aemet2download() used directly. station_id station_ids supplied, requested stations retained. ldata$df now includes n_days, number observed calendar days station-year. can used remove incomplete curves, example subset(ld, ld$df$n_days >= 360). aemet2lfdata() now builds objects fda.usc::ldata() constructor. Standard fda.usc methods plot(), subset() [ therefore work directly returned object. inventory aemet2lfdata() can either inventory data.frame path file previously saved aemet2inventory(file = ...). allows inventory downloaded reused. aemet2lfdata() warns requested variables available data reports station coordinates unavailable. CSV files written UTF-8 BOM, using ; field separator , decimal separator, independently current locale. CSV input read consistently accented characters station names preserved. applies aemet2df(), aemet2download(), aemet2csv(), aemet2fdata() aemet2lfdata(). HTTP requests now use base R (utils::download.file()), removing dependency httr. API key included error messages. AEMET “data” responses (404) retried, rate-limit responses (429) retried. Failed requests retried default (max_attempts = 2, retry_wait = 60). attempts can requested control = list(max_attempts = 3). Error messages now clarify station identifiers correspond AEMET station_id (indicativo, e.g. "1387"), wmo_id. New example data file inst/extdata/aemet_example.csv, containing stations 1387 B228 2023-2024, allows examples vignette run without API key. Internal helper functions longer exported help index. LazyData removed DESCRIPTION, since package contain data/ directory. inst/CITATION updated.
